g.text: TECHFEST IIT BOMBAY // OFFICIAL TECHNICAL STREETWEAR HOODIE CONCEPT
STAGE: PRODUCTION CONCEPT // EDITABLE VECTOR SPEC
IIT BOMBAY // ANNUAL SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY FESTIVAL
IIT BOMBAY POWAI // LAT 19.1334° N // LONG 72.9133° E // CONCEPT 2026-27
Laser-engraved hexagonal monogram with Tech Blue anodized terminal ring. 4.5mm round braided cord.
3M Scotchlite reflective tech-blue thermal film bonded along the anterior raglan contour for nocturnal visibility.
Precision screen-printed on the outer left forearm in matte off-white with Tech Blue registration guide wire.
Water-based discharge underbase preserves fabric softness without stiff plastisol hand-feel. High-density silicone chest crest with micro-embossed detail.
This hoodie translates Techfest IIT Bombay's 29-year legacy into a
luxury technical streetwear garment. Designed for researchers, engineers,
and future-builders who push the frontiers of what is possible.
• Brutalist architectural wireframes of the iconic IIT Bombay campus.
• Orbital trajectory mathematics and aerospace exploration telemetry.
• Monochromatic planetary geometry with disciplined Tech Blue signals.
• Premium wearable ergonomics without excessive merchandising clutter.
Independent creative design proposal. Non-commercial visual study.
Primary garment foundation. Deepest matte black.
Controlled energetic accents, trajectory arcs & aglet tips.
Hero back typography and high-legibility markings.
Architectural blueprint linework and technical metadata.
Application: Main back headline, chest wordmark, sleeve slogan, tagline.
Application: Editorial captions, technical callouts, garment dimensions.
Independent concept design created for design review. Not an official merchandise release.
